description: Tuples with the same atomic equality and order pattern satisfy the same quantifier-free formulas.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.qf_transport.{u, v} {o : Bool} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  {N : Type v} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).Structure M]
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).Structure N]
  {φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).BoundedFormula Empty n} (hφ : φ.IsQF)
  {x : Fin n → M} {y : Fin n → N}
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Similar
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.relation
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.relation x y) :
  φ.Realize Empty.elim x ↔ φ.Realize Empty.elim y
